section.name: UCx: Use-case title
section.t: Scenario: Describe the useful service, actors, sensitive information, privacy need, and plaintext/decryption trust boundary.
(1) Example Flows: Describe a representative high-level flow.

ol.li: The requester specifies the task, authorized inputs, and permitted output.
The trusted party prepares and encrypts the required data and retains the decryption secret.
The evaluator performs the agreed operation on ciphertexts.
The authorized trusted party receives and decrypts the encrypted result.
The authorized recipient uses the permitted output.

section.t: (2) Post-conditions: State the intended functional outcome, protected information, and authorized disclosures. Identify relevant G1/G2 mappings and information outside the protection boundary.

(3) Existing Non-HE Solutions Covering the Use-Case Functionality: Explain existing approaches and their trust assumptions in one concise paragraph. Identify the specific limitation that motivates FHE.

t.strong: (4) Potential New Requirements Needed to Support the Use Case:

ul.li: UCx-R1 (G1, where applicable): Protected computation or selection. State the useful operation and protected information.
UCx-R2 (G2, where applicable): Controlled decryption and release. State key custody, recipients, and permitted disclosure.

section.t: Explain how FHE could address the objectives, the complementary controls needed, and relevant evaluation dimensions. Add primary references and distinguish demonstrated feasibility from proposed work.
